स्कन्द् I. €1 <ab>P.</ab> (स्कन्दति, स्कन्न) .²1 To leap, jump. .²2 To rise, ascend, jump upwards. .²3 To fall, drop; स्यन्त्वा स्यन्त्वा दिवः शम्भोर्मूर्ध्नि स्कन्त्वा भुवं गताम् <ls>Bk. 22. 11</ls>; <ls>Ms. 7. 84</ls>. .²4 To burst or leap out. .²5 To perish, come to an end; चस्कन्दे तप ऐश्वरम् <ls>Bhāg. 5. 9. 3</ls>. .²6 To be spilled, ooze. .²7 To emit, shed. .²8 To go, move. .²9 To become dry. .²10 To perish. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (स्कन्दयति-ते) .²1 To pour out, effuse, shed, emit (as the seminal fluid); एकः शयीत सर्वत्र न रेतः स्कन्दयेत् क्वचित् <ls>Ms. 2. 180</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">9. 50</ls>. .²2 To omit, neglect, pass by. --II. €10 <ab>U.</ab> (स्कन्दयति-ते) To collect.
